related.title: 板材深引伸製程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：材料收支閉合，三種非成品去向明確，品質與材料效率各有獨立結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The material ledger closes, non-product destinations are explicit, and quality and material efficiency have separate conclusions.
related.difference: 由杯底與側壁面積估胚料直徑，辨認忽略圓角與厚度變化的限制。
related.differenceEn: Estimate blank diameter from cup-bottom and wall areas, retaining corner-radius and thickness limitations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 近似不可壓縮塑性變形使金屬體積守恆；質量效率=有用成品體積/投入體積，氧化損失另列。 教學投入體積 120 cm³，成品 90 cm³，加工餘量 10 cm³，飛邊 20 cm³，密度視為一致。 90+10+20=120 cm³；成品利用率 90/120=75%。飛邊不是額外憑空增加的體積。
薄板厚度不變且忽略圓角時，πD²/4=πd²/4+πdh，因此 D=√(d²+4dh)。 教學杯直徑 d=60 mm，高 h=40 mm，板厚 1 mm；只作幾何估算。 D=√(60²+4×60×40)=114.891 mm；D/d=1.915，並不因此保證可單次引伸。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Approximately incompressible plastic flow conserves metal volume; utilization=useful finished volume/input volume, with oxidation loss separate. Teaching input 120 cm³, finished part 90 cm³, machining allowance 10 cm³ and flash 20 cm³ at common density. 90+10+20=120 cm³; finished utilization=90/120=75%. Flash must come from the same input volume.

With constant thickness and negligible corners, πD²/4=πd²/4+π dh, so D=√(d²+4 dh). Teaching cup diameter d=60 mm, height h=40 mm, thickness 1 mm; geometry only. D=√(60²+4×60×40)=114.891 mm; D/d=1.915 does not prove one-draw feasibility.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工業壓縮機系統整合
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：材料收支閉合，三種非成品去向明確，品質與材料效率各有獨立結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The material ledger closes, non-product destinations are explicit, and quality and material efficiency have separate conclusions.
related.difference: 在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
related.differenceEn: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 近似不可壓縮塑性變形使金屬體積守恆；質量效率=有用成品體積/投入體積，氧化損失另列。 教學投入體積 120 cm³，成品 90 cm³，加工餘量 10 cm³，飛邊 20 cm³，密度視為一致。 90+10+20=120 cm³；成品利用率 90/120=75%。飛邊不是額外憑空增加的體積。
若用實測平均比能耗e，洩漏能量E=q_leak te；此估算忽略卸載控制造成的非線性。 合成洩漏0.30 m³/min、運行4000 h/年、平均比能耗0.11 kWh/m³，三者使用同一自由空氣基準。 漏氣體積0.30×60×4000=72000 m³/年；耗能7920 kWh/年。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Approximately incompressible plastic flow conserves metal volume; utilization=useful finished volume/input volume, with oxidation loss separate. Teaching input 120 cm³, finished part 90 cm³, machining allowance 10 cm³ and flash 20 cm³ at common density. 90+10+20=120 cm³; finished utilization=90/120=75%. Flash must come from the same input volume.

With measured average specific energy e, leak energy E=q_leak te; the estimate omits unloading-control nonlinearities. Synthetic leak 0.30 m³/min,4000 h/year, specific energy 0.11 k Wh/m³, all on one free-air reference basis. Leak volume=72000 m³/year; estimated energy 7920 k Wh/year.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
